title: Coastal Intercept
subtitle: Inland launch → high-altitude target · WGS84 · ECEF replay
description: End-to-end trajectory of a two-stage intercept scenario, replayed from validated 6-DoF simulation telemetry. Positions come directly from the source ECI state rotated into ECEF; attitudes are converted with the same Earth-rotation quaternion. No visual exaggeration is applied to trajectory geometry.

frames.eciToEcef: Rz(-omega*t), omega=7.2921150e-5 rad/s, ECI==ECEF at t=0

experiment.name: Nominal coastal intercept, single deterministic shot
experiment.purpose: Replay a validated 6-DoF trajectory for scientific visualisation and interactive inspection.
experiment.engine: missile-interception 6-DoF point-mass/attitude integrator, 10 ms telemetry grid, seeker + terminal guidance

dispersion.note: Campaign dispersion values from the source project configuration; this payload is the nominal deterministic case, not a Monte-Carlo sample.

notes: Monte-Carlo batch artifact holds 0 case(s); the 100-case campaign cited by the legacy reports cannot be re-derived from this workspace.
Source telemetry was generated from a dirty working tree; source.commit is recorded as 'workspace'.

events.label: LAUNCH
events.description: Lift-off from launch site (40.00 N, 110.00 E).

events.label: SEEKER LOCK
events.description: Seeker acquired the target at 25.0 km slant range.

events.label: TERMINAL HANDOVER
events.description: Midcourse guidance handed over to the terminal seeker.

events.label: INTERCEPT
events.description: Closest approach 17.15 m at t = 674.340 s.

observables.label: Altitude
observables.description: WGS84 geodetic height above the reference ellipsoid.

observables.label: Speed
observables.description: Speed relative to the Earth-fixed (ECEF) frame.

observables.label: Mach
observables.description: Speed divided by local speed of sound (USSA1976).

observables.label: Dynamic pressure
observables.description: q = 0.5 rho V^2 in the Earth-fixed atmosphere.

observables.label: Seeker off-boresight
observables.description: Line-of-sight angle relative to the seeker boresight.

observables.label: Mass
observables.description: Current vehicle mass including remaining propellant.

observables.label: Fin deflection
observables.description: Recorded cruciform fin deflections relative to trim (+ up fin shown).

observables.label: Body rate
observables.description: Recorded body angular rates p (roll), q (pitch), r (yaw).
